summary: WPP plc furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a home-country disclosure notice) announcing a Chief Financial Officer succession. The filing is captioned 'Directorate Change – CFO Succession' and covers the planned transition of the company's finance chief, a board-level change at the advertising group. No stake, price, premium, or consideration terms are stated. No advisor is named. The structural note is that WPP reports as a foreign private issuer on Form 20-F, so this 6-K is the disclosure vehicle; no deal, tender, or vote mechanics apply. What to watch: successor identity, effective date, and any guidance reset risk around the transition.
